[P2] Keep individual preview tokens budget-bounded

Calling `getTextLength()` forces Jackson to finish and buffer the complete string token before the preview budget can reject it. A single very large field can therefore duplicate the payload and exhaust heap in both preview paths. Apply bounded Jackson stream-read constraints for strings, names, and numbers before parsing, then replace or reject oversized tokens without materializing them; add a constrained-heap regression with one oversized field.
